VACANCY CIRCULAR 02/2026

Sub.: Filling up the post of Chief Draughtsman of
Central Water Commission by Deputation (including
Short-Term Contract) basis.

It is proposed to fill up 39 (tentative) posts of the grade of Chief
Draughtsman, General Central Service Group ‘B’ Gazetted, Non-
Ministerial, in Pay Level-7 (Rs. 44,900-,42,400), in the offices of Central
Water Commission and other encadred organisations located in different
parts of india by Deputation (including Short-Term Contract) basis.

2. Eligibility: Officers of drawing cadre under the Central Government or
State Government or Union Territories or statutory or autonomous
organization or public sector undertakings or universities or recognized
research institutes: -

(i) (a) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in parent cadre or
department; or

(b) with five years of regular service in the post in level -6 of the pay
matrix (Rs. 35400-Rs.Il2400) or equivalent in parent cadre or
department; and

(ii) possessing the following educational qualification and experience,
namely: - ह

(a) Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised
university or institute;

(b) Three years’ experience in the concerned field* from Central
Government or State Government or Union Territory administrations or
statutory or autonomous organization or public sector undertakings or
universities or recognised research institutes.

Desirable:- Six months experience on the software relating to Auto-
CAD

*The concerned field prescribed by the department may be elaborate in
the form of Duties & responsibility** as under.

 
A-3502/3/2026-E-X ॥/266255/2026

Note 3.- The departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the
direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for
appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationist shall not be eligible
for consideration for appointment by promotion.

Note 2.- The period of deputation including the period of deputation in
another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in
the same or some other organization or department of the Central
Government shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

Note 3.- The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation shall be
not exceeding fifty six (56) years as on the closing date of receipt of
applications.

3. **The Chief Draughtsman shall primarily perform the following duties
and responsibilities: -

a. Administrative supervision of draftsman of other categories; overall
supervision, guidance & checking of accuracy.

b. Drafting work of structural/fabrication/reinforcement/survey
drawings using CADD software such as AutoCAD.

c. Checking of project estimates.

d. Checking of tender documents, construction schedules, etc.:
checking of topographical contours, maps, GIS, hydrological data,
etc.; checking of specifications for tenders, NITs, agreements;

e. Checking of rate analysis including that of non-scheduled items.

f. To keep the drawings in digital format including uploading &
downloading in the ‘Digital Archival System for Engineering
Drawings’ maintained by CWC.

g. Responsible for complete orientation of new drawing staff.

h, To keep an account of scientific and mathematical instruments.

4, The pay of the officers selected will be regularized in accordance with
the DoPT O.M No, 6/8/2009-Estt(Pay ii) dated 7.06.20i0 as amended from
time to time. Other terms and conditions for appointment on deputation as
stipulated in the orders/rules issued by the Government of India from time to
time shall also be applicable.

5, It is requested that application in duplicate in the enclosed prescribed
Performa along with :

i. Copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years upto 2024-25 duly attested
by the Controlling Authority;;
ii. Vigilance Clearance Certificate;
iii, Certificate regarding Major/Minor Penalty, if any, imposed during the last
0 years; and
iv. Integrity Certificate.
In respect of the interested and eligible officers, who can be spared

Secretary, Establishment-X Section, Central Water Commission,
3rd Floor(S), Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-l0066 so as
to reach within 60 days from the date of publication of this Circular in the
Employment News.

6, The Vacancy Circular along with the prescribed proforma may be
accessed from the website of the Central Water Commission at
https://cwc.gov.in/ > Citizen Corner > Recruitment. Applicants are

or absorption
